create_s2t_transformer_model: create a speech-to-text transformer model from an S2TTransformerConfig using the factory function
create_s2t_model_via_factory: build a complete S2T transformer model by instantiating S2TTransformerFactory with a config and calling create_model
create_encoder_frontend: create an encoder frontend with a Conv1dFbankSubsampler feature extractor and sinusoidal position encoder
create_decoder_with_causal_attention: create a transformer decoder with causal self-attention and encoder-decross attention layers
create_final_projection: create a linear projection layer mapping model_dim to target_vocab_size with normal weight initialization
